# @stackline/dynamic-dedupe full reference

`@stackline/dynamic-dedupe@{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}` is an independent maintained
continuation of `dynamic-dedupe@0.3.0` under the MIT license.

## API

- `activate(extension = '.js', subdirs = 2)`: install an idempotent CommonJS
  extension hook that reuses exports for matching module identity inputs.
- `deactivate(extension = '.js')`: disable the hook and restore its exact
  predecessor when it remains outermost.
- `reset()`: clear Stackline identity records without clearing `require.cache`.

Identity uses length-framed source text, basename, and selected parent directory
components with SHA-256. This prevents path-boundary ambiguity in the upstream
implementation. Runtime configuration is validated before hook mutation.

## Verification

The release checks copied trees, path-boundary collisions, repeated activation,
loader composition, disabled embedded hooks, preserved symlinks, CommonJS deep
imports, ESM configuration, TypeScript 3.9/current, Node 12-24, Linux/macOS/
Windows, package contents, clean installs, aliases, coverage, and production
dependency audit. The package has zero runtime dependencies.

## Scope

Native ESM imports do not pass through `require.extensions`. Use package-manager
constraints, peer dependencies, import maps, or a dedicated loader for ESM.

Install: `npm install @stackline/dynamic-dedupe`
Alias: `npm install dynamic-dedupe@npm:@stackline/dynamic-dedupe`
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-dynamic-dedupe
Security: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-dynamic-dedupe/security/policy
